The '''2019 Tilburg Star Wars CCG weekend''' was announced for 9–10 November 2019 in Tilburg, Netherlands.<ref name="tilburg">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1277719#p1277719 Star Wars CCG in Tilburg 9/10th November], Shadow 14, Players Committee forum (18 October 2019).</ref>
